about.title: Our Story
about.intro: 100% natural supplements, made in Morocco to support every step of the fertility journey — alone or as a couple.
about.paragraph1: BioFertMaroc was born from a simple observation: fertility involves both partners, yet support for men is still too often overlooked. We wanted to create formulas designed specifically for her and for him, to take alone or together.
about.paragraph2: Every product — BellaFert, FertiMen, Ferti Power, PowerMen, SmokeClean Men, Relaxes Woman, CycleCare — is formulated from natural active ingredients, manufactured in GMP-certified facilities, with no artificial additives.
about.paragraph3: Our protocols are designed around 3 months, the time it takes for a full maturation cycle of eggs or sperm. No shortcuts — just consistency and formulas that work.
